'''Harson Nild''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Director of Core World Operations]] in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Armageddon" /> He made a note on the SIS dossier on [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]], remarking on rumors of the doctor's activity as Fixer Fifteen<ref name="Lokin">{{TORcite|type=codex|SIS Dossier: Doctor Eckard Lokin}}</ref> while Nild was a junior agent,<ref name="Armageddon" /> and sent a message<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|type=message|"Lost" Communications Device|Harson Nild}}</ref> to the individual who helped the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] agent [[Ebenga]] recover the Imperial spy [[Alma (Ord Mantell)|Alma's]] recording device on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">{{TORcite|type=general|Scavenger Hunt|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> Nild oversaw a SIS attempt to capture the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Cipher Nine]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. When an SIS strike team partnered with the remnants of an Imperial terrorist group failed to capture or kill the agent, Nild reached out to the Cipher via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. He explained that he had ordered all SIS agents to withdraw and offer Nine a chance to surrender. He assured Nine that the Republic didn't torture its prisoners and promised that Nine would eventually be returned to Imperial space. The Cipher Agent refused and staged a series of explosions in the [[Military History Museum]] to make it seem like the Cipher was dead.<ref name="Armageddon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harson Nild is a character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', who appears in the Imperial Agent's storyline. When Nild reaches out to the agent, the player can choose to either acknowledge or ignore him.

If [[Ardun Kothe]] is spared on [[Quesh]], Nild will not appear during the Agent's class quest on Corellia.
